text:
Ruth: Heads-up from QA on small phones: when the left rail is collapsed and you swipe the table horizontally, the first column can get pushed under the rail and the row kebab becomes untappable. Video: https://imgur.com/smallphone-swipe.mp4
Diego: can repro on iPhone SE (2nd gen). Steps: Console -> Policies table -> collapse rail -> quick horizontal swipe -> first column clips under rail. Looks like the table container doesn't reserve the collapsed rail gutter.
Kaya: UX idea: when rail is collapsed we should reserve a 64px gutter on the left (touch safe) and allow the table to scroll inside the remaining width. Also show a faint divider to indicate the reserved area.
Nate: dev note: simplest approach is `.container--rail-collapsed { padding-left: 64px; } .table-inner { overflow-x: auto; }` but that changes layout and could break sticky column positions. Alternative: use an overlay safe-area element that sits over content but has pointer-events: none to allow taps to pass through to table until user opens rail.
Ruth: accessibility: ensure the reserved gutter doesn't hide focusable elements. When the rail is collapsed, focusable table cells should have tabindex=0 and visible focus outlines. Also update SR announcement: "Rail collapsed, table interaction area adjusted" when user toggles rail.
Diego: prototype patch: add `.rail--collapsed .table-wrapper { padding-left: 64px; transform: translateZ(0); }` and clamp at `@media (max-width: 380px)`. I'll include visual tests and device clips.
Kaya: copy tweak: in compact rail state change tooltip "Expand" -> "Open nav" (shorter) and on very small screens shorten column header "Created at" -> "Created".
design-bot: Figma uploaded with compact-gutter spec and interaction notes: https://figma.com/file/COMPACT/rail-gutter-mobile :memo:
Ruth: putting this as RD-3789 P2. Diego + Kaya to pair on the PR. Please include an e2e for iOS Safari and a short demo video in the PR.
